Package index

Model specification and fitting

Declare a spatial or spatio-temporal Gaussian-process model and fit it to field or trial data by marginal-likelihood maximisation.

gpfield_spec()
Specify a gpfield Gaussian-process model
gp_fit()
Fit a gpfield Gaussian process to field or trial data

Prediction and change of support

Predict the latent field at point support, or at a different support – paddock-scale block averages with the predictive variance propagated through the support map.

gp_predict()
Predict a gpfield surface, optionally at a different support
block_support()
Describe a block (areal) support for change-of-support prediction

Field and trial smoothing

The one-call path from a row-column multi-environment-trial layout to a smoothed surface, and a colourblind-safe raster of it.

gp_field_smooth()
Smooth a row-column field or trial layout
gp_field_plot()
Draw a smoothed field surface (requires ggplot2)

Orchestra contract manifest

Emit a smoothed surface as the orchestra’s versioned, integrity-hashed ensemble-manifest contract, and verify it.

as_orchestra_manifest()
Emit a gpfield result as an orchestra manifest
orchestra_manifest
The orchestra ensemble-manifest contract (gpfield-side implementation)
verify_manifest()
Verify an orchestra manifest's payload integrity

Abstention

The typed refusal returned when the data support or spatial range cannot bear the requested prediction resolution.

gpfield_abstention()
Construct a typed gpfield abstention
is_gpfield_abstention()
Is an object a gpfield abstention?

Classes

The S7 object hierarchy carrying an analysis end to end.

gpfield_spec_class
A gpfield model specification
gpfield_fit_class
A fitted gpfield Gaussian process
gpfield_prediction_class
A gpfield prediction at a requested support
gpfield_smooth_class
A fitted-and-smoothed field

Package

gpfield gpfield-package
gpfield: Change-of-Support Gaussian-Process Regression for Field and Multi-Environment-Trial Data
